解答 方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=a(1-\cos t),\quad \frac{dy}{dt}=a\sin t,\quad \text{可得 }\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{\sin t}{1-\cos t}=\cot\frac{t}{2}.$$

方程两边再同时对 $x$ 求导一次，

$$\text{则有 }\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}=\frac{d\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)}{dx}=\frac{d\left(\frac{dy}{dx}\right)/dt}{dx/dt}=\frac{-\frac{1}{2}\csc^2\frac{t}{2}}{a(1-\cos t)}=-\frac{\csc^4\frac{t}{2}}{4a},\quad (t\ne 2n\pi,n\in Z)$$
